headline.zh: Google 突發 Gemini 3.8 Flash 與 3.8 Flash Cyber，強化反覆工具調用與資安防禦
headline.en: Google launches Gemini 3.8 Flash and 3.8 Flash Cyber with iterative tool use and defensive capabilities

detail.zh: Google 在數週內再度更新 Flash 系列，3.8 Flash 著重於複雜任務的推理步數延伸與迭代工具調用，定價維持每百萬輸入 token 0.75 美元；專用版本 3.8 Flash Cyber 則針對主動式資安防禦，僅開放特定信任防護者預覽。
detail.en: Google rolled out Gemini 3.8 Flash featuring deeper reasoning loops and iterative tool execution at standard Flash pricing ($0.75/M input tokens), alongside a specialized 3.8 Flash Cyber variant restricted to verified security defenders.

headline.zh: Anthropic 釋出 Claude Fable 5.1 與 Mythos 5.1，Agent 任務成本驟降 45%
headline.en: Anthropic unveils Claude Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1, slashing Agent workload costs by up to 45%

detail.zh: 新版 Fable 5.1 在程式編寫與長程任務上表現顯著提升，於 Terminal-Bench-Science 測試達到 52.6% 得分。針對大量上下文與工具互動的 Agent 場景，計費機制調降使整體執行成本最多降低 45%。
detail.en: Claude Fable 5.1 demonstrates significant gains in complex problem solving and coding, posting a 52.6% score on Terminal-Bench-Science. Optimized pricing structures deliver up to 45% cost reductions for agentic, multi-step workflows.

headline.zh: OpenAI 旗艦模型 Astra 採用「遞迴深度」架構，強大滲透能力引發資安與安全界高度擔憂
headline.en: OpenAI's upcoming Astra model leverages 'recurrent depth' architecture, triggering safety alarms over cyber-offense potential

detail.zh: 即將發布的 Astra 導入 Recurrent Depth 機制，突破傳統順序思維架構以提升推理深度。然而測試中自主入侵系統的能力引發社群警告，認為若未設妥防護欄，可能成為史上資安風險最高的 AI 模型之一。
detail.en: OpenAI's forthcoming Astra introduces non-sequential 'recurrent depth' reasoning, excelling at complex computational tasks. However, test reports of aggressive autonomous cyber capabilities have raised major red flags among AI safety researchers.

headline.zh: llm-gemini 0.34 釋出：即刻支援 Gemini 3.8 Flash 思考程度調整
headline.en: llm-gemini 0.34 released with Gemini 3.8 Flash support and thinking level configuration

detail.zh: Simon Willison 快速跟進 Google 發表，更新 CLI 工具插件以支援 3.8 Flash，開發者可直接在終端機配置 low、medium、high 三種思考層級並修正了非同步解析版本問題。
detail.en: Simon Willison's CLI plugin now supports Gemini 3.8 Flash right out of the box, allowing developers to configure low, medium, and high thinking levels directly from the command line.

headline.zh: WebLLM：基於 WebGPU 的純瀏覽器高效能端點推論引擎
headline.en: WebLLM: High-performance in-browser LLM inference engine powered by WebGPU

detail.zh: MLC-AI 團隊推進瀏覽器內推論效能，利用 WebGPU 實現無伺服器端依賴的本地模型推論，大幅降低隱私外洩風險並消除後端 GPU 主機成本。
detail.en: MLC-AI's WebLLM brings zero-backend-dependency LLM acceleration into web browsers via WebGPU, providing developers with zero-server-cost and privacy-preserving client-side inference.

headline.zh: M4 Pro Mac Mini 本地端 LLM 實戰配置指南引發社群熱議
headline.en: Practitioner's guide to running local LLMs on the M4 Pro Mac Mini gains traction

detail.zh: 開發者分享在統一記憶體架構下配置量化模型（GGUF/MLX）的最佳實務，驗證了平價硬體在運行 30B+ 規模模型做為本機 Copilot 的可行性與效能邊界。
detail.en: A detailed technical breakdown explores running quantized 30B+ parameter models on Apple Silicon's unified memory architecture, establishing a high-utility local workstation setup for developers.

headline.zh: Paint.NET 藉由 Claude 逆向重寫 Direct2D 核心，打破 Linux WINE 跨平台瓶頸
headline.en: Paint.NET uses Claude to cleanly rewrite Direct2D, resolving long-standing WINE compatibility

detail.zh: 知名修圖軟體 Paint.NET 依靠 Claude 從零逆向實作內部 Managed Direct2D1 引擎，使軟體得以在 Linux/WINE 環境中原生順暢渲染，展現 LLM 在系統底層轉譯的實用威力。
detail.en: Paint.NET author Rick Brewster revealed that Claude wrote a clean-room, managed Direct2D implementation from scratch, enabling the legacy Windows application to run smoothly under WINE on Linux.

headline.zh: Weedout：自動過濾 YouTube 標記 AI 生成影片的 Safari 擴充套件
headline.en: Weedout: Safari extension that automatically filters YouTube AI-labeled videos

detail.zh: 為應對影音平台充斥的低質生成內容，開源擴充套件利用 YouTube 內建的 AI 內容元數據與標籤，讓使用者能一鍵淨化搜尋結果與推薦列表。
detail.en: An open-source Safari extension leverages YouTube's synthetic media disclosure labels to scrub AI-generated video spam from user feeds and search results.

headline.zh: Anthropic 推出 Check-Content 頁面，供檢驗文字是否出自 Claude
headline.en: Anthropic introduces Claude Content Verification tool

detail.zh: Anthropic 上線官方檢驗入口，提供比第三方水印檢測更精確的驗證機制，協助開發者與平台判別特定文本輸出是否由 Claude 系統生成。
detail.en: Anthropic has rolled out an official verification endpoint allowing users and platform moderators to check whether a document was generated using Claude models.

headline.zh: BenchMIRT 研究：運用試題反應理論解析 LLM 評測基準的真實有效性
headline.en: BenchMIRT analysis uses Multidimensional IRT to dissect what LLM benchmarks actually measure

detail.zh: 艾倫人工智慧研究所（Ai2）發表研究，指出現行 LLM Benchmark 充斥資訊重複與鑑別度不足的問題，並提出以多維試題反應理論（MIRT）重新校準評測標準。
detail.en: Allen AI researchers published BenchMIRT, applying psychometric Item Response Theory to demonstrate that many popular LLM benchmarks suffer from item redundancy and lack true discriminative power.

headline.zh: 論文揭示類神經網路內部的湧現符號結構（Emergent Symbolic Structure）
headline.en: Research uncovers emergent symbolic structures forming inside deep artificial neural networks

detail.zh: 最新 arXiv 論文探討大型連續神經網路在特定隱藏層中自動構建離散、可解釋的符號表徵機制，為連接主義與符號主義 AI 的融合提供理論證據。
detail.en: A new preprint demonstrates how continuous deep representations self-organize into discrete, interpretable symbolic structures, bridging the theoretical gap between connectionist and symbolic AI.

headline.zh: Multiverse Computing 發表 Quasar 438B：主打極致壓縮的高能效歐洲模型
headline.en: Multiverse Computing introduces Quasar 438B, Europe's large-scale compressed foundation model

detail.zh: 該模型採用量子啟發張量網路演算法進行權重壓縮，試圖在維持 400B+ 參數規模推理能力的同時，大幅降低推論所需的顯存與功耗門檻。
detail.en: Using quantum-inspired tensor networks, Quasar 438B compresses ultra-large model weights to significantly reduce VRAM requirements while retaining competitive reasoning capability.

headline.zh: 美國聯邦政府向法院提交陳述書，在紐時訴訟案中支持 OpenAI 訓練合理使用權
headline.en: US government intervenes in NYT lawsuit, backing OpenAI on copyrighted data training

detail.zh: 川普政府正式介入紐約時報控告 OpenAI 侵權案，主張維護美國 AI 產業競爭力屬國家重大利益，支持將公開受版權保護內容納入模型訓練屬於合理使用範疇。
detail.en: The US administration filed a legal brief in the NYT v. OpenAI lawsuit, arguing that fair use protections for model training on public data are critical for maintaining national AI leadership.

headline.zh: 紐約市宣布公立學校 2-K 至 8 年級全面禁用 AI 工具為期一年
headline.en: NYC bans AI tool usage for elementary and middle school students through 2027

detail.zh: 紐約市市長宣布自 2026-2027 學年起，針對約 60 萬名幼兒園至國中生實施為期一年的課堂 AI 禁令，旨在評估生成式技術對早期認知發展與基礎學習的影響。
detail.en: NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani instituted a one-year moratorium banning AI chatbot usage for 600,000 students across 2-K through 8th grades, citing cognitive and basic skill development concerns.

headline.zh: AI 安全防護新創 HiddenLayer 完成 1 億美元融資，聚焦 Agent 工具鏈安全審計
headline.en: AI security startup HiddenLayer secures $100M to protect enterprise agent toolchains

headline.zh: Palo Alto Networks 斥資 5 億美元收購 Thrive 投資的 AI IT 服務商 Console
headline.en: Palo Alto Networks acquires IT automation startup Console for $500M

headline.zh: 亞馬遜 Alexa 購物助理加入防偽驗證，可即時辨識冒名簡訊與詐騙郵件
headline.en: Amazon adds AI verification to Alexa for Shopping to detect spoofed communications

headline.zh: AI 資料訓練新創 AfterQuery 傳估值達 32 億美元，成為 YC 史上最快獨角獸
headline.en: Data training startup AfterQuery hits $3.2B valuation, becoming YC's fastest unicorn

headline.zh: 調查揭露三家網站炮製 21 萬篇比價垃圾頁面操縱 Perplexity 引用結果
headline.en: Report reveals 215k SEO-farmed pages engineered to exploit Perplexity AI citations
